parties.respondent: High Court of Gujarat and Ors.

summary: Promotion under 65% quota; merit-cum-seniority vs seniority-cum-merit; selection list invalid for applying wrong principle; Rule 5(1)(i) Gujarat State Judicial Service Rules, 2005 violation; selection based on merit first followed by seniority; promotion of lower-scoring candidates despite higher-scoring petitioners; writ allowed.
legal_provisions_cited: Gujarat State Judicial Service Rules, 2005 Rule 5
A.I.J.A. v. Union of India (2002) 4 SCC 247
B.V. Sivaiah v. K. Addanki Babu (1998) 6 SCC 720
N.M. Thomas v. State of Kerala (1976) 2 SCC 310
final_judgment: Writ petition allowed; selection list dated 10.03.2023 set aside; State directed to prepare fresh list based on merit-cum-seniority as per Rules.
